limitations: Full app mode launches the project Electron process. Renderer automation uses a localhost CDP endpoint; native OS dialogs, menus, and the project main process are not controllable.
Full app mode launches the project Electron process. Renderer automation uses a localhost CDP endpoint; native OS dialogs, menus, and the project main process are not controllable.
Renderer mode tests the web frontend only. The Tauri Rust backend and invoke() commands are not executed.
Full-app mode provides webview UI automation and renderer console capture. Tauri backend APIs, backend logs, native OS dialogs, and menus are not controllable.
Native operating-system UI outside the webview is unsupported.
